reader.requirement: At --std 85 the SORT statement's INPUT PROCEDURE and OUTPUT PROCEDURE phrases must accept THROUGH and THRU interchangeably between procedure-name-1/-2 and procedure-name-3/-4, each spelling giving the same inclusive procedure range (paragraphs or sections).

edition-consulted.switches: the Format-2 table SORT introduction gate (Constructs.TableSort2002), only when no USING/GIVING/procedure phrase is written; a Format-1 SORT with procedures is not gated
reserved-word status per edition: both THRU and THROUGH reserved at all four editions

reader.edition-search: grep Edition.Year|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior in SortBinder.cs (one hit, ScreenSameClauses, not on this rule); grep THRU/THROUGH across src (grammar alternatives, ReservedWords table, directive words only)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers paragraph ranges in both phrases; not section ranges or the degenerate form with procedure-name-2 omitted after THRU

probes.printed: S1 FIRST AIPB1 / S1 MID / ... / S2 NEXT AIPB1 / END; EXPECT: MATCH
probes.expected: both spellings bind the three-paragraph range (SR5)

probes.printed: R A, R B, R C, R C, R B, R A (exit 0)
probes.expected: section ranges IN-1 THROUGH IN-2 and IN-1 THRU IN-2 identical; ascending then descending

probes.printed: error COBOL5506: unexpected 'GIVING' ... expected a user-defined word
probes.expected: THRU must be followed by procedure-name-2 (general format)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR5  (4.4.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5

reader.notes: The grammar admits (THRU | THROUGH) as one alternative and SortRange never asks which word was written, so equivalence holds by construction and is the same code at every edition. Probes at --std 85 show paragraph and section ranges behave identically under either spelling.

refuter.evidence: S1lowq-001 (--std 85): lowercase 'sort ... thru' and mixed-case 'ThRu'/'Through' with qualified procedure-names (P1 OF IN-S thru P2 OF IN-S; O1 IN OUT-S through O2 IN OUT-S) and a one-paragraph range P1 THRU P1 printed R A/R B/R C then -- then R B, the excluded P3/O3 never ran. S2nop1-001: 'INPUT PROCEDURE IS THROUGH P1' refused COBOL5506. Grammar takes (THRU|THROUGH) as one alternative; no edition arm on the path. cite.py: OK §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR5 the text is in SR5.
